title: fix(electron): support Unicode unlinked mentions
body:
## Summary / 摘要

我是邵梦月，在 Boss 上得到这份作业，提交至此。

Fix Electron demo unlinked-mention detection for CJK and other Unicode note names while preserving whole-word behavior for alphabetic scripts.

修复 Electron demo 中中文、日文、韩文及其他 Unicode 笔记名称无法被识别为未链接提及的问题，同时保留字母文字的整词匹配语义。

## Motivation / 背景与动机

`LinkIndex.getUnlinkedMentions()` previously wrapped an escaped note name with JavaScript `\b` boundaries. JavaScript defines `\b` around ASCII-style word characters, so note names such as `项目计划` produced no matches at all. Accented names also had inconsistent boundaries, for example `Café` could not be handled with true Unicode word semantics.

This made the backlinks panel incomplete for multilingual vaults even though the underlying text contained exact note-name mentions.

- Issue: N/A (identified through code review and a failing regression test)
- Roadmap: N/A (bug fix)
- OpenSpec: N/A (restores existing behavior; no public API or new capability)

## Changes / 变更内容

- `apps/electron-demo/src/renderer/link-index.ts`
  - Replace ASCII-only `\b` matching with case-insensitive Unicode matching.
  - Add code-point-safe boundary checks for alphabetic and numeric scripts.
  - Use exact substring semantics when a note name starts or ends with a CJK character, because CJK prose commonly has no whitespace word separators.
  - Keep regex escaping, wiki-link exclusion, snippets, offsets, and caching behavior unchanged.
- `apps/electron-demo/test/link-index.test.ts`
  - Add a CJK regression covering two unseparated `项目计划` mentions.
  - Add an accented-Latin regression proving `Café` matches independently but not inside `caféine`.

## Testing / 测试

The CJK regression was verified to fail before the implementation (`0` matches instead of `2`).

- [x] `node_modules/.bin/vitest run` — 34 test files, 539 tests passed
- [x] `node_modules/.bin/vitest run apps/electron-demo/test/link-index.test.ts apps/electron-demo/test/sample-vault.test.ts` — 51 tests passed
